quests.title: Ail'Vorith Starter Quest
notes: Read the Imbued Parchment you start with as a new character in Ail'Vorith:
You are looking for Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa, who are mere feet away from where you spawn as a new character in Ail'Vorith.

quests.title: Escort Head Researcher Aashir
notes: This quest has two parts, both are dependent on the time of day within the game.

Part 1 of the quest in Shaded Dunes starts at 6 PM game time. If you complete Part 1, the Night Harbor version of Head Researcher Aashir will spawn and remain up until 6 AM game time. He will promptly despawn in Night Harbor at 6 AM. Requiring you to re-complete Part 1, in order to complete the reward turn in. It is recommended to complete Aashir's Journal before completing Part 1 of the quest.

Head Researcher Aashir is only up during the day time. He spawns at 6AM game time and will be attacked by the risen skeletons when they spawn at 6PM game time. Head Researcher Aashir is lower level than the risen skeletons so they will kill him, requiring you to wait until 6PM the next day. If you hail Head Researcher Aashir during the day he will dismiss you.
In Shaded Dunes around the entrance to Ancient Crypt, risen skeletons and cultists spawn promptly at 6 PM game time and will despawn at 6 AM game time. They are on a 7 minute respawn timer.
Equip Aashir's Journal into an open bag slot. Add each journal page and click Combine to create Aashir's Journal.
Locate Head Researcher Aashir near the Ancient Crypt zoneline in Shaded Dunes.
This can only be started after 6:00 PM game time once the risen skeletons have spawned nearby.
After a brief delay, Head Researcher Aashir will start walking through the ruins towards Night Harbor. He does not provide any additional speech at this point of time.
You are to escort him to the far end of the ruins, killing anything along the way. There can be upwards of 3-4 Risen Skeletons attacking him at once.

Plan for a small group to assist in keeping the Risen Skeletons off of Head Research Aashir. If Head Research Aashir dies while being escorted, you will need to wait until 6:00 PM game time the following in-game day to try again.
If there are any Risen Skeletons in the area, Head Researcher Aashir will rush to attack them.
When you have reached the northern end of the ruins, Head Researcher Aashir will stop moving and he will give a brief statement.
